name: Inverse SE3 Transformation
definition: Computes the inverse of an SE3 transformation represented by a quaternion $q$ and translation $t$. The inverse rotation is the conjugate quaternion $q^*$, and the inverse translation is $-q^* \otimes t$ (rotated by the conjugate quaternion).
summary: Inverse SE3 Transformation computes the reverse rigid body motion of a 3D rotation and translation, enabling coordinate system conversions in volume rendering.
